name: The Westin Maui Resort and Spa
positioning: The Westin Maui Resort & Spa, Ka'anapali: an oceanfront resort on Ka'anapali Beach with six pools, a Heavenly Spa and Hawaiian cultural experiences
best_for: Families who want a beach resort with a large pool playground, water slide and kids club
Travelers who want Hawaiian cultural experiences and a private lounge in the Hokupa'a tower

facts.text: The resort has views of the Pacific, the islands of Lanai and Molokai, and Black Rock.
The family pool area has an interactive Keiki Splash Zone, and the resort has a 270-foot water slide.
Dew-drop-shaped cabanas made from bamboo and dark wood, designed exclusively for the resort, are scattered across the pool deck.
Hokupa'a tower guests get larger indoor and outdoor room layouts.
Cultural experiences at The Lanai include lei po'o making, talk story sessions, ukulele lessons, chef demonstrations and live music.
The resort has a Heavenly Spa by Westin offering massages, facials, body treatments and couples massages.
Guests can join an outrigger canoe experience, available daily for ages 6 and up.
Ulu Kitchen by Merriman is a beachfront restaurant using fresh island ingredients and food made from scratch.
The Westin Family Kids Club offers arts and crafts, nature adventures, lei-making and animal expeditions.
Whalers Village, with restaurants, shops and entertainment, is a block away.

highlights.text: The resort is oceanfront on Ka'anapali Beach.
The Kawaiola Aquatic Playground has six pools overlooking Ka'anapali Beach across 87,000 square feet.
Guests staying in the Hokupa'a tower get access to The Lanai, with panoramic views, Hawaiian breakfast and dinner bites, a private bar, infinity-edge cocktail pools and cultural experiences.
The Heavenly Spa has open-air lounge spaces with oceanfront views.
The Wailele Luau features a fire knife performance, hula and a traditional island-style dinner.

considerations.text: Kahului Airport, the main airport, is about 45 minutes from the hotel.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes it is a large resort with busy common areas.
